$Comment: What one cleared wave of the restless dead banks into each member's chest in the restless graveyard
(Dungeons/Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard.json, Run.Endless.Chest.PerWave): the run rolls it once
for every wave a member stood through, and the whole run's rolls land as one Claim when they leave or
when the run ends. The first run each day pays in full and later ones half, the dungeon's
Rewards.Diminish: the pool still draws in full, then every quantity halves, a leftover half paying by
chance. Its Voidtaken waves bank Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Boss_Wave instead.
Every roll in Rolls always pays: a festival token through the Currency reward kind, then favor with the
Hallowed and Festival Favor through the Reputation kind. Pool draws Rolls.Base times from Entries, each
as likely as its Weight against the rest, repeats allowed: Void Essence, one to three. Keep each roll
small, since a long run rolls it many times; Mmo_Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Wave.json adds Defense XP
Name: Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Wave
